name: Void Blessing grants the promised Mp5 buff and 30-minute duration through the native power-regen aura (#2096)
contract: 800194 Effect[0] is Aura 85 = SPELL_AURA_MOD_POWER_REGEN, EffectMiscValue=0=POWER_MANA, BasePoints 9+1=10 (deterministic, DieSides=1). AuraEffect::HandleModPowerRegen (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:150, 'implemented in Player::Regenerate') adds this flat amount to the target's mana-per-5-seconds stat -- the same mechanism WotLK's stock Mp5 buffs use, which is why the client renders it as 'restoring N mana every 5 seconds' even though EffectAmplitude=0 (not a literal periodic tick: SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_ENERGIZE, aura 24, is a different aura entirely). DurationIndex=30, SpellDuration.dbc id 30 = 1,800,000 ms = 30 min, matching the tooltip's '$d' exactly. The harness has no mana-regen-rate metric and exercising the real Mp5 tick would need real-time waits sensitive to other regen sources, so this asserts the installed aura and its carried modifier amount directly (aura, aura_duration_ms, aura_amount) per prior-audit convention, not a live regen measurement. Effect[2] (effect type 168, an unnamed Ascension custom effect dispatched to Spell::EffectNULL) is outside this issue's tooltip contract and is not asserted (see report Observations). Regression guard for behaviour that already works natively.
